ai_observations: Not a defect but a set problem worth reporting: Ditto holds a Choice Scarf and copied a Rillaboom whose first move it selected was Fake Out. Fake Out is only legal on the turn a Pokemon enters, so from turn 2 the Choice lock left Ditto with no legal move and it was forced to Struggle, taking recoil until Amoonguss killed it. Any Imposter copy of a Fake Out user has this failure mode; it is a consequence of Choice Scarf on Imposter, not of a bad AI choice.
could_this_be_cooler: The joke team already lands - the Imposter reveal and the Magikarp-to-Mega-Gyarados arc are the best parts. The one honest improvement is the Choice Scarf on Ditto: it converts the copy into a Struggling body within two turns. A Focus Sash or nothing at all would let the Imposter actually mirror the player's whole set, which is the joke. Not changed in this pass.
legality_notes: Authored set is legal. Flagging the Choice Scarf + Imposter + copied Fake Out interaction above as a design fragility rather than a rules problem.
